to-name: To Mary Christiana Boyle?

My dear [Mrs Boyle](/person/193)[^1]
I waited till all our plans had settled themselves to thank you, and say that we shall much enjoy coming to you for luncheon on Wednesday Our train is at 12.44

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Perhaps Mary Christiana Robins, wife of the Very Rev.

George David Boyle (1828-1901), dean of Salisbury 1880-1901.
